name: Kanjivaram Silk Saree
description: Rich maroon silk with a gold zari temple border and woven paisley pallu. 5.5 m saree with 0.8 m unstitched blouse piece. Dry clean only.

name: Banarasi Silk Saree
description: Royal blue Banarasi silk with an all-over floral jaal and a broad gold border. Includes 0.8 m blouse piece. Dry clean only.

name: Mysore Crepe Silk Saree
description: Soft emerald crepe silk with a slim gold zari border. Light to drape and easy to carry for weddings and puja. Blouse piece included.

name: Bandhani Cotton Silk Saree
description: Hand-tied bandhani dots in mustard, red and green on a cotton silk base. A bright pick for Navratri, Diwali and family functions.

name: Chanderi Cotton Saree
description: Sheer, lightweight chanderi in pastel pink with tiny silver motifs and a subtle border. Comfortable for long days.

name: Tant Cotton Saree
description: Crisp handloom tant cotton in ivory with a bold red border and small woven motifs. Breathable and ideal for everyday wear.

name: Georgette Sequin Saree
description: Flowing plum georgette with a sparkling sequin border. Lightweight and easy to drape for receptions and parties.

name: Organza Embroidered Saree
description: Peach organza with hand-finished floral embroidery along the border and pallu. Crisp fall with a graceful shimmer.

name: Patola Style Silk Saree
description: Geometric double-ikat inspired weave in red, blue and gold. A statement saree for weddings and festive evenings.

name: Printed Chiffon Saree
description: Airy aqua chiffon with a multicolour floral print. Pairs easily with a plain blouse for brunches and casual events.
